faq.question: Q1. What is KUDSIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KUDSIT Recruitment 2026 is an official notification issued by the Kerala University of Digital Sciences Innovation and Technology to fill 3 contract posts including Senior Technology Architect, Sr. QA & Delivery Manager, and Senior QA Analyst.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under KUDSIT Notification KUDSIT/303/AD AIII/2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across three different posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for KUDSIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Technology Architect post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B-Tech, BE, M-Tech, or MCA degree from a recognized University or Educational Institution along with the specified professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Senior Technology Architect post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit should not exceed 45 years as of the last date for submission of application, with age relaxations applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates.
